exposure: bilateral prophylactic occlusion balloon catheter placement in both internal iliac arteries
cohort: 30 patients with MAP treated at a single center between December 2007 and February 2014
finding: Introduction of the Triple-P procedure for MAP was associated with a significantly reduced rate of hysterectomy, PPH, and duration of hospital stay.
mod_finding: The Triple-P procedure (placental non-separation, myometrial excision, and uterine wall reconstruction) during cesarean delivery for morbidly adherent placenta was associated with a significantly reduced rate of hysterectomy and postpartum hemorrhage.
